data.mutation:
mutation UpsertOeeDaily($payload: [OeeDailyUpsertPayloadInput!]!) {
  upsertOeeDaily(payload: $payload) {
    id
    workcenterId
    periodDayAt
    oee
    availability
    performance
    quality
    scheduledTime
    unscheduledTime
    totalUnits
    goodUnits
  }
}

mutation UpsertOeeDaily($payload: [OeeDailyUpsertPayloadInput!]!) {
  upsertOeeDaily(payload: $payload) {
    id
    workcenterId
    periodDayAt
    oee
    availability
    performance
    quality
    scheduledTime
    unscheduledTime
    totalUnits
    goodUnits
  }
}
